deploy.alt: The deploy briefing before a solo match: the location, its map, the squad and the operator's ability, shown while the room loads.

hud-desktop.alt: A solo match on Office at the start: the operator in a lit room with the vision cone ahead, the HUD around the edges.

callouts.t: Hostiles left and the danger-zone timer
Weapon, magazine and reserve, reload ring

sound-rings.alt: Running and firing: the dashed ring around the operator shows how far that noise carries.

reload.alt: Reloading: the ring around the weapon icon fills while the magazine reloads.

ability-cd.alt: Benja's Ping just used: the sonar ring spreads out and the ability button shows its cooldown.

armour-break.alt: Armour gone: the armour bar is empty and the vitals panel flashes.

callouts.t: Armour bar empty: every hit now goes to health

low-health.alt: Low health: the health bar is short and the screen edges warn.

tactical-map.alt: The tactical map open over a match on Office: the whole floor with area names, your squad and every living hostile at its live position, zoom buttons on the right.

death.alt: RUN OVER: the results screen after losing a solo match, with time, hostiles downed, kills and accuracy.

victory.alt: ROOM CLEARED: the results screen after winning a solo match, with the medals earned listed.

tmap-room-zero.alt: The in-game tactical map of this location, opened at the start of a solo match: the floor plan with area names, the squad's position and every hostile's live position.
